result.topic_en: A page of Gauss's mathematical diary from 1801 to 1807. It explains why the diary lapsed in 1802–1804 and records later results: the proof of a theorem noted in May 1801, interpolation theory, methods of orbit determination, reducing the ellipse and hyperbola to the parabola, factoring (x^l−1)/(x−1), and the theory of cubic and biquadratic residues.
result.transcription:
Formulas permultas novas in Astronomia theorica utilissimas eruimus 1801 Mense Octob. [10]

Annis insequentibus 1802. 1803. 1804 occupationes astronomicae
maximam otii partem abstulerunt, calculi imprimis circa
planetarum novorum theoriam instituti. Unde evenit, quod
hisce annis catalogus hicce neglectus est. [-Viele dies Chare[?]-] Dies
itaque, quibus aliquid ad matheseos incrementa conferre datum
est memoriae exciderunt. ——

# Demonstratio theorematis venustissimi supra 1801 Mai. commemorati
quam per 4 annos et ultra omni contentione quaesiveramus tandem
perfecimus Comment. rec. I 1805. Aug 30.
Theoriam interpolationis ulterius excoluimus 1805 Novbr.
# Methodum, ex duobus locis heliocentricis corporis circa solem moventis
eiusdem [-orbitam-] elementa determinandi novam perfectissimam
deteximus. 1806. Januar.
# Methodum e tribus planetae locis geocentricis eius orbitam determi
nandi ad summum perfectionis gradum evehimus 1806. Mai.
# Methodus nova ellipsin et hyperbolam ad parabolam reducendi
1806 April.
# Eodem circiter tempore resolutionem functionis $\frac{x^l-1}{x-1}$ in factores
quatuor absoluimus.
# Methodus nova e quatuor planetae locis geocentricis, quorum
duo extremi sunt incompleti eius orbitam determinandi 1807 Jan 21
# Theoria Residuorum cubicorum et biquadraticorum incepta 1807 Febr. 15
ulterius exculta et completa reddita Febr. 17. Demonstratione adhuc eget:
# Demonstratio huius theoriae per methodum elegantissimum inventa
ita ut penitus perfecta sit nihilque amplius desideretur. 1807 Febr 22
Hinc simul residua et non residua quadratica egregie illustrantur.

methods.quote: Formulas permultas novas in Astronomia theorica utilissimas eruimus 1801 Mense Octob.

methods.what: Proof of a theorem recorded in May 1801, published in Comment. rec. I
methods.quote: Demonstratio theorematis venustissimi supra 1801 Mai. commemorati quam per 4 annos et ultra omni contentione quaesiveramus tandem perfecimus Comment. rec. I 1805. Aug 30.

methods.what: Determining orbital elements from two heliocentric positions
methods.quote: Methodum, ex duobus locis heliocentricis corporis circa solem moventis eiusdem [-orbitam-] elementa determinandi novam perfectissimam deteximus. 1806. Januar.

methods.what: Orbit determination from three geocentric observations, brought to full perfection
methods.quote: Methodum e tribus planetae locis geocentricis eius orbitam determinandi ad summum perfectionis gradum evehimus 1806. Mai.

methods.what: Reduction of elliptic and hyperbolic motion to the parabolic case
methods.quote: Methodus nova ellipsin et hyperbolam ad parabolam reducendi 1806 April.

methods.what: Factorization of the cyclotomic polynomial (x^l−1)/(x−1) into four factors
methods.quote: resolutionem functionis $\frac{x^l-1}{x-1}$ in factores quatuor absoluimus.

methods.what: Orbit determination from four geocentric positions, the two outer ones incomplete
methods.quote: Methodus nova e quatuor planetae locis geocentricis, quorum duo extremi sunt incompleti eius orbitam determinandi 1807 Jan 21

methods.what: Theory of cubic and biquadratic residues
methods.quote: Theoria Residuorum cubicorum et biquadraticorum incepta 1807 Febr. 15 ulterius exculta et completa reddita Febr. 17.

methods.what: Proof of the residue theory, which also illuminates quadratic residues and non-residues
methods.quote:
Demonstratio huius theoriae per methodum elegantissimum inventa ita ut penitus perfecta sit nihilque amplius desideretur. 1807 Febr 22
Hinc simul residua et non residua quadratica egregie illustrantur.

items.quote: Demonstratio theorematis venustissimi supra 1801 Mai. commemorati quam per 4 annos et ultra omni contentione quaesiveramus
items.english: The proof of the most beautiful theorem mentioned above in May 1801, which we had sought with every effort for four years and more

items.quote: Theoria Residuorum cubicorum et biquadraticorum incepta 1807 Febr. 15 ulterius exculta et completa reddita Febr. 17. Demonstratione adhuc eget:
items.english: Theory of cubic and biquadratic residues, begun 15 Feb 1807, further developed and completed 17 Feb. It still needs a proof:
